altText: A colorful MySpace-inspired concert flyer with retro browser windows, pixel icons, neon pink accents, layered band logos, and a grayscale live-show background. The flyer promotes the June 25 MySpace Tour show at McGuffie’s Live in San Diego featuring Pretty Suspect, Oathbound, Lookoutbelow, and another supporting band. Doors open at 8:00 PM, with $5 tickets at the door.

A colorful MySpace-inspired concert flyer with retro browser windows, pixel icons, neon pink accents, band photos, and layered band logos. The flyer promotes the June 23 MySpace Tour show at The Escondite in Los Angeles featuring Pretty Suspect, Oathbound, Daybreak Ends, and Dead Lakes. Doors are at 8:00 PM, the show starts at 9:00 PM, and entry is free.

Concert flyer for the MySpace Tour on Monday, June 22 at Transplants Brewing in Palmdale. The show features Pretty Suspect, Oathbound, and Revelry. Doors open at 6:30 PM and the show starts at 7:00 PM.

Concert flyer for the MySpace Tour stop on Sunday, June 28, 2026 at Dante’s in Portland. The show features Pretty Suspect, Oathbound, Foghorn, and Hangfire. Doors open at 5:30 PM. Tickets are $13 in advance or $15 at the door, available at danteslive.com.

Concert flyer for Saturday, June 20 at Smashed Live, 6412 Tupelo Dr, Suite A. The all-ages show features SALT, Pretty Suspect, Oathbound, and Hallway Scene. Doors open at 6:30 PM, music starts at 7:15 PM, and cover is $15.

Concert flyer for Friday, June 19th at The 520, 1236 Price Rd SE in Albany, Oregon. The all-ages show features Pretty Suspect, Hide Heaven, Drawn By Knives, Dead Nexus, Cosmic Waste, and Oathbound. Doors open at 6:00 PM, music starts at 6:30 PM. Tickets are $10 in advance and $20 at the door.
